title: Te Torona o te Pono
intro: Ka whiwhi tētahi rangatira mana nui, e mōhiotia ana mō tōna whakaaro nui me tōna torona whakahīhī, i tētahi karere ngaro mai i tētahi pūtake ngaro. Ka werohia ō rātou whakapono me tō rātou mana e tēnei whakawhitiwhiti kōrero ohorere, ka whakatakoto i a rātou ki tētahi haerenga tōrangapū hei whakamātautau i ō rātou hinengaro, ā, hei te mutunga ka arahi atu ki tētahi ara wairua hohonu. Ka taea e koe te hura i te tuakiri o tēnei ariki me ngā kaupapa i whakarerekē i tō rātou kingitanga katoa?
clues: I karakia mātou ko tōku iwi ki te rā, i te whai i ngā tikanga a ō mātou tūpuna.
He manu, he hūpī, te karere kāore i te tino tūmanakohia i kawe mai i tētahi reta ki ahau i tētahi rangatira whai mana.
Hei whakamātautau i te whakaaro nui o te kaituku, i tukuna atu e au ētahi taonga utu nui, engari i whakahokia mai, nā te mea he nui rawa atu te taonga a te kaituku mai i a Allah.
I mua i taku taenga atu ki te marae o te kaituku, i tere tonu te kawe whakamiharotia o taku torona whakahīhī ki reira.
I taku taenga atu, ka pātaihia mai mēnā nōku te torona i haria atu, ā, ka whakahoki ahau, 'Me te mea koia tonu.'
I tomo ahau ki tētahi whare nui, he papa tōna i whakaaro ahau he puna wai, ā, i taua wā o te miharo, ka tuku ahau i ahau i te taha o te Poropiti a Sulaiman ki a Allah, te Ariki o ngā ao.

arabic: قِيلَ لَهَا ٱدْخُلِى ٱلصَّرْحَ ۖ فَلَمَّا رَأَتْهُ حَسِبَتْهُ لُجَّةًۭ وَكَشَفَتْ عَن سَاقَيْهَا ۚ قَالَ إِنَّهُۥ صَرْحٌۭ مُّمَرَّدٌۭ مِّن قَوَارِيرَ ۗ قَالَتْ رَبِّ إِنِّى ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِى وَأَسْلَمْتُ مَعَ سُلَيْمَـٰنَ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verse: She was told, "Enter the palace." But when she saw it, she thought it was a body of water and uncovered her shins [to wade through]. He said, "Indeed, it is a palace [whose floor is] made smooth with glass." She said, "My Lord, indeed I have wronged myself, and I submit with Solomon to Allāh, Lord of the worlds." (27:44)
